$comment: The branch-protection policy this repository intends, as a versioned artifact (backlog B-M67-10).
Until now it lived only in the prose of issue #208, which means it could not be reviewed in a
diff, could not be diffed against reality, and would have been re-derived from memory by whoever
applied it. CLAUDE.md is explicit that two layers guarantee different things: the local hook
guarantees work is BORN on `workspace`; branch protection is what makes the PR MANDATORY. This
repo has the first and not the second — `git push origin main` works today.
Apply with `pnpm protect:branches --apply`; compare with `pnpm protect:branches` (read-only).
required_status_checks starts EMPTY on purpose. Requiring a check that cannot pass converts a
missing gate into a jammed one, and this repository spent a whole cycle removing gates that were
impossible by construction. Add contexts here as they turn green and stay green — the honest
order is: fix the check, watch it hold, then require it.

required_pull_request_reviews.$comment: Zero approvals: a solo-maintainer repo cannot satisfy a 1-approval gate, and a gate that can only be bypassed teaches bypassing. The PR itself is the guarantee being bought here.

$unprotected.workspace: Deliberately NOT protected: it is where work is born, and direct commits there are the normal flow (git-safety.md § 1). Protecting it would break the very branch the rules require everyone to use.
